prompt:
# Independent PRE — frade-light-diagram-editor

Request exactly gpt-6-sol with reasoning xhigh, selected from design.md section 8 and accepted-scope.md. Use only the immutable explicit Frade packet in the shared verified read-only runtime. No original checkout, other worktrees, credentials/secrets/global settings, writes, network or apps. Read review policy, root/scoped AGENTS, full proposal/design/tasks/deltas, accepted scope, baseline source/hash inventory, BDD, verification plan, original applicable specs/tests and documentation amendment. Validate packet completeness; missing required inputs blocks approval.

Review implementability and correctness, not code that has not been implemented. Confirm explicit exception to theme-following/editor reference geometry, fixed light versus Windows forced colors, complete owner-based portal/frame coverage, shared roles rather than a second resolver, palette/backdrop fidelity, canonical token-adoption boundary, source-binding and historical-test integrity, first-paint/ACK/revision/rollback preservation and exact allowed paths. Check practical native/frame composition, reference-variable precedence, no domain/routing/persistence operations, honest unsupported/OS-owned surfaces and bounded strategy/command matrix. Existing benchmark budget/workload/timeouts/assertions cannot be relaxed. No P02 or routing predecessor.

Report findings with severity, packet-relative path/line, causal explanation and required correction; distinguish product decision from implementation issue. A reviewer cannot approve a new scope or replace human visual acceptance. Blockers mean FAIL. Conclude with exactly one standalone line GATE_STATUS: PASS or GATE_STATUS: FAIL. Do not claim implementation, runtime or visual PASS. Unavailable/ambiguous execution is BLOCKED by the receiving harness, never inferred PASS.


Apply authority is decisions/apply-authorization.md. The earlier planning-only proposal text describes the completed request and is superseded only by this explicit apply authorization. Review the whole plan before judging implementation. New production files/tests are not implemented, so PRE is not a request to certify runtime or future tests. Packet contains complete relevant baseline files; inspect relevant sections rather than assuming large historical files require a complete repetitive reading. Main specifications are current approved origin; only deltas describe the new authorized behavior. Historical exceptions are not new waivers. No prior stage PASS closes this stage.
